svg.title: A leaf in a forest
svg.text: Every random thing in the game comes from one number that changes every time anything asks for one.
the leaf you want: one cast
frame that lands the Power Nut
how wide the forest is: every value the random number can take
499 steps by the time the house loads.
the canopy: where branches that started apart grow into each other
Generator: libkmc rand() in the game's code, a signed 32-bit number; starts at 0 when the N64 is switched on.
